a_before_b.rationale: Adapter-based finetuning is a parameter-efficient technique that can be applied to various objectives, including pre-training, and does not require understanding the specific shift from text completion to instruction-following via SFT.

b_before_a.rationale: Understanding how SFT shifts model behavior does not depend on knowing the specific mechanics of adapter modules, as SFT can be performed via full fine-tuning without adapters.
